item.text: {"summary":"A small to medium-sized tree native to Victoria, New South Wales and Queensland, Australia, kurrajong grows from wet coastal districts to semi-arid interiors. It has water-storing trunks, variable-shaped leaves and bell-shaped cream-to-pink flowers; Aboriginal peoples also roasted its seeds after removing the irritating hairs.","humanEdibility":"yes","edibilityNote":"Aboriginal peoples removed irritating hairs from the pods, cleaned and roasted the seeds; European settlers roasted and crushed seeds as a coffee supplement.","evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p2","s1:p7"],"humanEdibility":["s1:p7"]}}
